race.comment: AZUKI (10) comes into this chasing a hat-trick of wins after a tough win at Beaudesert, followed by an impressive last start performance at Ipswich when showing a good turn of foot to score by over a length. He has been placed in 6 of his 7 starts here on his home track, and he can break his duck by getting the job done again. KADALL (5) has not won for some time, but he is usually thereabouts. He has Jaden Lloyd in the saddle this time for his peak run, and he can figure in the top 3 again. MISHANI PRINCE (7) is back in form at this level, and he handles any type of track conditions, A wide gate makes it tougher, but he did win his penultimate start off a similar draw, so stick with him. THE DEPUTY (1) saves his best for his home track here, and he will notice a drop in class for this. Each way value, despite carrying the top weight.
